scripts.clean: node scripts/clean.mjs && vp run extension#wxt:prepare && vp run @recnrun/isolator#wxt:prepare && vp run @recnrun/worker-bootstrap#build
scripts.test:components:local: vp test --config apps/website/vitest.browser.config.ts && vp test --config apps/extension/vitest.browser.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:local: vp run --no-cache website#build && vp run --no-cache extension#build:test && playwright test --workers=1
scripts.deps: depcruise packages tests --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs && depcruise apps/website --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/website/tsconfig.deps.json && depcruise apps/extension --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/extension/tsconfig.deps.json && depcruise apps/fixture/src apps/fixture/scripts apps/fixture/tests --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/fixture/tsconfig.deps.json && depcruise apps/isolator/src apps/isolator/tests apps/isolator/wxt.config.ts apps/isolator/vitest.config.ts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ts-config apps/isolator/tsconfig.deps.json
scripts.duplication: jscpd --threshold 4 --fail-on-empty apps/website/src apps/extension/src apps/isolator/src packages/domain/src packages/bridge/src packages/isolation-core/src packages/isolation-core/vendor packages/worker-bootstrap/src packages/brand/src apps/fixture/src apps/fixture/public
scripts.prepare: vp config && vp run extension#wxt:prepare && vp run @recnrun/isolator#wxt:prepare && vp run @recnrun/worker-bootstrap#build
